title: nullbox saved rules
description: Fixed sender and recipient rules that act without asking Jev. They run in order, before the Jev rule sets.

address.description: An address (deals@shop.example) or a whole domain with its subdomains (@shop.example). me@x.example also matches me+anything@x.example. Case is ignored.

name.description: Identity of the rule; its audit key is saved:<name>.

mode.description: dry_run (the default) only records matches; live applies them.

to.description: A recipient in To or Cc.

subject_contains.description: Text the subject must contain (case is ignored).

remove.description: archive takes matching mail out of the inbox with the review label nullbox/review/saved-rules/<name>; delete moves it to Trash (archives instead while the delete lock is on).

stop.description: When the rule is live and matches, skip the later saved rules and the Jev rule sets.

allow_protected.description: Allow mark_read and remove on starred or important mail.
